newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * Romania preserved all its chances of being invited to negotiations for EU membership at the Union's December summit, said deputy Mariana Stoica, head of a Romanian parliamentary delegation to the EU, upon return from Strasbourg.
* President Emil Constantinescu is expected to make an official visit to China later this year.

* The International Monetary Fund's chief negotiator for Romania Poul Thomsen is due to arrive in Bucharest on Tuesday. Thomsen will join the IMF's expert team -- in Romania since last week -- in order to evaluate the stage of the country's compliance with a memorandum singed in April.
Thomsen is due to spend two weeks in Romania.
